# SPE r05 plan: C2 on Sonnet 6 vs C2 on Sonnet 5.5

## Specify (rows for the r05 table in `spe/spec/spec.md`)

| ID | Requirement | Source | Test |
|---|---|---|---|
| R05-1 | Run C2 unchanged on Sonnet 6. | User: "Sonnet 6 just shipped." | The only difference between the two arm configs is the model ID. |
| R05-2 | Pin Sonnet 6 to the exact model ID from Anthropic's models page. | Decision. C2 is pinned in r04. | Each trial logs the model ID it got back. A trial with a mismatched ID is void. |
| R05-3 | Re-run C2 on Sonnet 5.5 in the same run as the baseline arm. | Decision | Both arms use the same tasks, trial count, and Workflow run. |
| R05-4 | Freeze tasks and graders at their `spe-r04` versions. Grader bug fixes from r04 failures still go in. | Decision. This keeps the model effect clean. | Task and grader hashes match `spe-r04`, apart from listed fixes. The control regrade measures those fixes. |
| R05-5 | Defer each r04 proposal that changes C2 to r06. Log each as a default with the reason "one change per config". | r04 Proposed table | Each proposal has an Adopt or Defer line in `disagreements.md`. |
| R05-6 | Flag a metric as saturated if C2 scored at or near 1.0 on it in r04. A Sonnet 6 gain on that metric cannot be measured. | Stop rule: "every configuration passes everything" | The saturation flag appears in the predictions file and the prediction log. |
| R05-7 | Keep the judge model the same as in r04. If the judge is a Sonnet model, note that it shares a family with both arms. | Decision | The judge model ID in the r05 Workflow arguments matches r04. |
| R05-8 | Whether production moves to Sonnet 6 is the user's call. | Halt rule | Logged in `disagreements.md` as an open decision with owner "user". |

## Predict (saved to `spe/predictions/r05.yaml` before any run)

Default: each cell starts from the r04 measured value in `spe/prediction-log.md`. The repo has no Sonnet 6 evidence yet, so its column also starts at "same as last round" with the band doubled.

| Metric | C2 / Sonnet 5.5 | C2 / Sonnet 6 | Why | Grader check |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Task pass rate | r04 value, r04 band | r04 value, 2x band | Same config and tasks. I have no in-repo reason to move the Sonnet 6 number. | Code checks per task |
| Tool errors per trial | r04 value, r04 band | r04 value, 2x band | C2 prompts were tuned on 5.5. Sonnet 6 may call tools differently. | Transcript tool-error count |
| Tool calls per trial | r04 value, r04 band | r04 value, 2x band | Same as above | Transcript count |
| Tokens per trial | r04 value, r04 band | r04 value, 2x band | No stated reason to move it | Usage log |
| Runtime per trial | r04 value, r04 band | r04 value, 2x band | Launch-week load may slow the new model. Rate limits count as harness errors. | Workflow timing |
| Cost per trial | r04 value, r04 band | r04 tokens x Sonnet 6 price, 2x band | Price comes from current docs | Usage log x price table |

A hit means the measured value falls inside the band. A number moves from "same as last round" only for a reason written in its Why line.

## Evaluate

- Script: copy r04 to `spe/evals/harness/r05-workflow.js`. Set `ROUND = 5` in one constant. The model ID comes from per-config arguments and never appears in prompt text.
- Gates before launch:
  1. Grader selftest. The oracle answer passes. The empty and wrong answers fail.
  2. Control. Regrade the r04 results with the r05 graders. The scores should match r04 apart from listed grader fixes.
  3. Dry run on 3 cells with `args.only`. At least one cell runs on Sonnet 6, to confirm the model ID resolves and the result schema is valid.
- Workflow arguments: `round: 5`, `configs: ["C2-sonnet-5.5", "C2-sonnet-6"]`, the r04 trials per cell, the r04 top-up cap, `maxSpendUSD`, `maxAgents`, `only`.
- Phases: Trials, Grade, Judge, Top-up, Synthesis, failure analysis, completeness critic.
- Peek scan: void any trial that read `spe/evals/` or `spe/predictions/`.
- Rate limits and API errors on the new model get retries with backoff. They are logged as harness errors, not model failures.
- Cost estimate (unmeasured): the r04 run cost for the 5.5 arm, plus r04 tokens times the Sonnet 6 price for the new arm.

## Commits (local only, no push)

`SPE r05 specify`, `SPE r05 predict` (plan copy to `spe/plans/r05.md` plus `r05.yaml`, before any harness work), `SPE r05 evaluate (harness)`, `SPE r05 evaluate (results): <headline>`, `SPE r05 learn`, tag `spe-r05`.

## Halt and report if

- the Sonnet 6 model ID cannot be confirmed from the docs,
- the spend cap is reached,
- the control regrade changes without a listed grader fix,
- or a trial read the answer keys.
